frozen_before: any model in this study was fitted or scored
market_family: NBA full-game lines: winner (KXNBAGAME), point spread (KXNBASPREAD), total points (KXNBATOTAL); regular season
prediction_cutoff: scheduled tip; features use same-season games on strictly earlier calendar dates. No injury, lineup or minutes input exists in this dataset
labels: final score from the certified dataset for fitting and point metrics; Kalshi OFFICIAL results (vault snapshot-20261116) for contract-level probability scores
baseline: record_strength = walk-forward ridge on win pct, Pythagorean pct, residual and close-game record; climatology = expanding mean

hypotheses.claim: adding efficiency_uncatalogued to the record-strength reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin

multiple_testing: Holm across all 10 hypotheses on the TEST seasons (alpha 0.05)
not_claimed: no sportsbook or Kalshi price is used; team-level inputs only, so availability-driven errors are expected and are not modelled
holdout_rule: 2026 and 2027 season outcomes are blanked before any fit unless --holdout; one-shot
